snippet.title: Sancticide - Official LaunchTrailer
snippet.description:
Sancticide Leaves Early Access – Full 1.0 Launch on March 11th
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635050/Sancticide/ 
Sancticide is a melee-focused third-person action game with roguelite elements, set in a world where the Biblical Apocalypse has stalled mid-collapse.
Players take on the role of Ezechiel the Seventh, a Sin Collector tasked with enforcing divine will in a broken world where Heaven’s bureaucracy has failed to finish the End of Days.
#Sancticide #gaming #videogames #pcgaming #trailer #steam
